# Dusrel — Full Content (llms-full.txt)

> Dusrel builds free, privacy-first apps: an image compressor/resizer (ShrinkIt), an LRC lyrics maker (Ricsline), a resume builder (ResumeForge) and PDF tools. Apps run locally in the browser wherever possible — no accounts, no tracking, no data selling. Motto: "YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS".

This file is the full-text companion to https://dusrel.com/llms.txt — the complete text of dusrel.com's key pages in one Markdown file, for AI systems that want the details, not just the links. Every page also exists in Hindi under https://dusrel.com/hi/ (for example https://dusrel.com/hi/privacy-policy/). The app and tool pages themselves work fully in the browser; nothing is uploaded to a server.

FAQ

## Questions, answered

Everything you might want to know about Dusrel.

Is Dusrel really free?

Yes. Every app’s core features are free, forever — no trials, no paywalls for the basics.

Do I need to create an account?

No. The apps work right away with no sign-up. A single optional Dusrel account will sync your stuff across the ecosystem.

How do you make money if you never sell data?

Dusrel is built by an independent solo developer and is free for everyone. If paid options ever come, they will stay honest and privacy-respecting — your data will never be for sale.

Do the apps work offline?

Most processing happens right on your device, so your files never leave it. An internet connection is only needed to load the app itself.

Which devices are supported?

Any modern browser on phone, tablet or desktop works today. Native Android and iOS apps, plus browser extensions, are on the roadmap.

What data do you collect?

As little as possible. We don’t build profiles or sell anything — read our privacy promise for the plain-language details.

## Your privacy matters.

Join the ecosystem of free apps that respect you. Your data stays yours — always.

Source: https://dusrel.com/apps/shrinkit/

## ShrinkIt

Resize images in seconds, privately

Free online image resizer — shrink, compress and convert images right in your browser. No signup, no uploads, no watermarks.

[Open app ↗](https://shrinkit.dusrel.com)[Download](https://dusrel.com/apps/shrinkit/download/)[More from Dusrel](#more)
- 100% client-side — photos never leave your device
- Resize by percent, pixels, or target file size
- Batch processing up to 50 images

## Everything you need to shrink images

### Smart resizing

Resize by percentage, exact pixels, or target a precise file size like 20KB or 50KB.

### Batch processing

Drop up to 50 images at once and resize them all together.

### Format conversion

Convert between JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF and more while you resize.

### Private by design

Everything runs in your browser with Web Workers. Your photos are never uploaded.

### Zero metadata

Strips EXIF and metadata from outputs for extra privacy.

### Free forever

Every feature is free with no watermarks, no accounts and no limits on the basics.

## Your photos stay yours

ShrinkIt processes everything on your device. Nothing is uploaded to a server — your photos are never ours to see or sell.

## Frequently asked questions

Is ShrinkIt free?+

Yes — every feature is free. No accounts, no ads, no watermarks and no premium tier.

Are my images uploaded to a server?+

No. ShrinkIt runs 100% in your browser, so your photos never leave your device.

Which image formats can I shrink?+

JPG, PNG, WebP, GIF, AVIF and more. Resize by percentage, exact pixels, or a target file size like 20KB or 50KB — up to 50 images at once.

Does ShrinkIt remove EXIF metadata?+

Yes. Output files are stripped of EXIF and metadata, so location and camera details never travel with your photos.

## Page: Ricsline

Source: https://dusrel.com/apps/ricsline/

## Ricsline

Make perfect LRC lyrics, synced to the beat.

A free LRC lyrics maker that runs right in your browser. Sync lines to the music, manage your lyrics library, and export clean .lrc files — no installs, no sign-ups.

[Open app ↗](https://dusmamud.github.io/ricsline/)[More from Dusrel](#more)
- Tap-to-sync timing with millisecond precision
- Built-in library to save and manage your lyrics
- Export clean .lrc files in one click

## Everything you need to sync lyrics

### Tap-to-sync timing

Press spacebar (or tap) in time with the music to lock every lyric line to the beat.

### Lyrics library

Save, browse and manage all your synced lyrics in a built-in library — always at hand.

### One-click .lrc export

Copy or download clean, standards-compliant .lrc files ready for any player.

### 20 languages

The full interface speaks your language — switch between 20 locales in one click.

### Fast & lightweight

Opens instantly, works offline once loaded, and respects your device’s battery.

### Free forever

Every feature is free, with no account needed and no paywalls for the basics.

## Your lyrics stay on your device

Ricsline works entirely in your browser. Your songs and lyrics are never uploaded to a server, never profiled, and never sold — your music is your business.

## Frequently asked questions

What is an LRC file?+

LRC is a lyrics format that stores every line with a timestamp, so music players can show and highlight each line in sync with the song.

How does tap-to-sync work?+

Play the song in the maker and tap (or press the spacebar) as each line is sung — Ricsline stamps every line with millisecond precision. Fine-tune afterwards with a global offset and inline editing.

Do I need an account to use Ricsline?+

No. Ricsline runs in your browser with no sign-up, and your synced songs are saved in a library on your own device.

How do I export my lyrics?+

Download a clean .lrc file in one click, copy the synced lyrics to your clipboard, or export them as JSON.

## ResumeForge

A beautiful resume in minutes, ready to print.

ResumeForge is a free resume builder that runs entirely in your browser. Pick a template, fill in your details, and download a print-ready PDF — no account, no watermark.

[Open app ↗](https://dusmamud.github.io/resumeforge/)[More from Dusrel](#more)
- 20 professional templates
- Live A4 preview with page-break markers
- Print-ready PDF — free

## Everything you need to get hired

### 20 professional templates

Choose from 20 polished templates designed to look great on paper and on screen.

### Live A4 preview

See exactly how your resume will print, with page-break markers so nothing gets cut off.

### Print-ready PDF download

Export a crisp, high-quality PDF in one click — ready to send or print.

### Autosave in your browser

Your work is saved automatically as you type. Close the tab, come back later, pick up where you left off.

### 20 languages

Build your resume in 20 languages, with full right-to-left support where it matters.

### Free, no signup

No account, no trial, no watermark. The core is free, forever.

## Your resume stays yours

ResumeForge works entirely on your device. Your personal details are never uploaded to a server, never tracked, and never sold — because we never sell your data.

## Frequently asked questions

Is ResumeForge free?+

Yes — all 20 templates and PDF downloads are free, with no sign-up and no watermarks.

Where is my resume data stored?+

Only in your browser, on your device. Nothing is uploaded to a server, and autosave keeps your latest draft ready when you come back.

How many resume templates are there?+

20 designs, from Traditional to modern layouts. You can switch templates at any time without losing your content.

Can I download a print-ready PDF?+

Yes. The live A4 preview shows page breaks before you download, so the PDF you get prints exactly the way it looks on screen.

Which PDF tools are included?+

Is PDF Tools free?+

Yes, completely free — no account needed and no forced watermarks added to your files.

Is there a file size limit?+

## Download ShrinkIt

Get ShrinkIt on your device — free, private, no signup.

ShrinkIt resizes and compresses images right inside your browser. Nothing is uploaded to a server — your photos never leave your device, which makes ShrinkIt one of the most private image tools you can use.

The Chrome extension puts ShrinkIt one right-click away: find any image on the web, right-click it, and resize or compress it instantly — no new tab, no upload, no account.

[

Chrome extension

v1.0.0 · 407 KB · 2026-10-20

Chrome, Edge or Brave (Manifest V3 supported)Open download page→](https://dusrel.com/apps/shrinkit/download/chrome/)

All downloads are free. No accounts, no tracking.

## Frequently asked questions

Is the ShrinkIt Chrome extension free?+

Yes — ShrinkIt is completely free, with no accounts, no ads and no premium tier. Every feature is available to everyone.

Does ShrinkIt upload my images to a server?+

No. All resizing and compression happens locally in your browser. Your images never leave your device, and ShrinkIt collects no data about you or your photos.

Why does the extension ask for permission to access all sites?+

ShrinkIt needs that permission for one reason only: to fetch the image you right-click on, so it can resize it. It never reads page content, never tracks your browsing, and only touches the exact image you choose.

How do I update or uninstall the extension?+

For this manual (ZIP) install, download the new version from this page and repeat the Load unpacked steps — your settings carry over. To uninstall, open chrome://extensions and click Remove on the ShrinkIt card. Once ShrinkIt is on the Chrome Web Store, updates become automatic.

## ShrinkIt for Chrome extension

Chrome, Edge or Brave (Manifest V3 supported)[Download now](https://dusrel.com/downloads/shrinkit-chrome-1.0.0.zip)

Version 1.0.0 · 407 KB · shrinkit-chrome-1.0.0.zip

## System requirements
- ✓A Chromium-based browser — Chrome 88+, Edge 88+ or Brave
- ✓About 2 MB of free disk space

## How to install
- 1

Download and unzip

Click the download button above and extract the ZIP to a folder on your computer.
- 2

Open the extensions page

In your browser address bar, type chrome://extensions and press Enter.
- 3

Enable Developer mode

Turn on the "Developer mode" toggle in the top-right corner.
- 4

Load the extension

Click "Load unpacked" and select the folder you extracted in step 1.
- 5

Pin it to the toolbar

Click the puzzle-piece icon in the browser toolbar and pin ShrinkIt so it is always one click away.

Prefer automatic updates? ShrinkIt is coming to the Chrome Web Store soon — the store version will update itself.

## Frequently asked questions

Is the ShrinkIt Chrome extension free?+

Yes — ShrinkIt is completely free, with no accounts, no ads and no premium tier. Every feature is available to everyone.

Does ShrinkIt upload my images to a server?+

No. All resizing and compression happens locally in your browser. Your images never leave your device, and ShrinkIt collects no data about you or your photos.

Why does the extension ask for permission to access all sites?+

ShrinkIt needs that permission for one reason only: to fetch the image you right-click on, so it can resize it. It never reads page content, never tracks your browsing, and only touches the exact image you choose.

How do I update or uninstall the extension?+

For this manual (ZIP) install, download the new version from this page and repeat the Load unpacked steps — your settings carry over. To uninstall, open chrome://extensions and click Remove on the ShrinkIt card. Once ShrinkIt is on the Chrome Web Store, updates become automatic.

TOOLS

## Free tools, zero fuss

Handy little tools that run entirely in your browser. No accounts, no uploads, no tracking — just open and use.

Every Dusrel tool works the same way our apps do: the work happens on your device, not on our servers. The password generator creates passwords with cryptographic randomness that never leaves your browser, and the username generator builds its ideas locally too.

More tools will land here over time. For now, start with the two essentials below.

## Password Generator[Open tool →](https://dusrel.com/pass/password-generator/)

Strong, random passwords generated locally in your browser — nothing is ever sent to a server.

Generated locally in your browser with cryptographic randomness (Web Crypto API). Nothing is sent to a server — Dusrel never sees your passwords.

## Page: Password Generator

Source: https://dusrel.com/pass/password-generator/

[Tools](https://dusrel.com/pass/)/Password Generator

## Password Generator

Strong, random passwords — created on your device, never on a server.

…

Copy↻

Strength ·

Password length16 characters

Uppercase (ABC) Lowercase (abc) Numbers (123) Symbols (#$&) Exclude look-alikes (0, O, 1, l, I)Generate new password

Generated locally in your browser with cryptographic randomness (Web Crypto API). Nothing is sent to a server — Dusrel never sees your passwords.

A strong password is your first line of defence online. This generator creates truly random passwords using the Web Crypto API — the same cryptographic randomness your browser uses for secure connections — so every password is unpredictable and unique.

Aim for at least 16 characters with a mix of uppercase, lowercase, numbers and symbols: that combination carries over 100 bits of entropy, which would take an enormous amount of computing power to crack by brute force. Use a different password for every account, and store them in a password manager.

## How to create a strong password
- 1

Set the length

16 characters is a strong default. Longer is always better — use 20 or more for important accounts like email and banking.
- 2

Pick the character types

Keep all four types on for maximum strength. If a website rejects symbols, turn symbols off instead of shortening the password.
- 3

Exclude look-alikes if you type by hand

The "exclude look-alikes" option removes 0, O, 1, l and I — handy when a password must be read aloud or typed manually.
- 4

Copy it into your password manager

Generated passwords are not saved anywhere. Copy the one you like and store it in your password manager right away.

## Frequently asked questions

Is this password generator safe to use?+

Yes. Passwords are generated locally in your browser with crypto.getRandomValues, a cryptographically secure random source. Nothing is sent to or stored on any server.

What makes a password strong?+

Length and randomness. A random 16-character password using all character types has over 100 bits of entropy — far stronger than a short "complex" password or anything a human invents, which attackers can often guess from patterns.

Can I reuse one strong password everywhere?+

No. If one website leaks it, attackers replay it on other sites ("credential stuffing"). Use a unique generated password for every account.

Does Dusrel store the passwords I generate?+

Never. Generation happens entirely on your device; when you refresh or close the page, the password is gone. That is why copying it into a password manager matters.

## Word Counter

Words, characters and reading time — counted live, right in your browser.

Clear text

Your text is counted locally in your browser — nothing is uploaded, stored or seen by Dusrel.

Word counts matter more than we admit: essay limits, article lengths, speech timings, report briefs, even the 280 characters of a post. This counter updates as you type or paste, showing words, characters with and without spaces, sentences, paragraphs and estimated reading time.

Like every Dusrel tool, the counting happens entirely on your device. Your drafts — assignments, applications, unpublished articles — are never uploaded anywhere.

## How to use the word counter
- 1

Paste or type your text

Drop in a whole essay or write directly in the box — the counts update on every keystroke.
- 2

Read the numbers you need

Words for length limits, characters for posts and meta descriptions, sentences and paragraphs for structure.
- 3

Check the reading time

Reading time assumes about 200 words per minute — handy for speeches, videos and blog posts.
- 4

Trim or expand to fit

Edit in place and watch the counts move until your text fits its target.

## Frequently asked questions

How are words counted?+

Any run of characters separated by spaces, tabs or new lines counts as one word — the same method used by most editors and submission portals.

Is my text uploaded or saved?+

No. Counting runs locally in your browser; your text is never sent to a server or stored by Dusrel.

How is reading time calculated?+

At an average adult reading speed of about 200 words per minute. A 1,000-word article therefore shows roughly 5 minutes of reading time.

Does it count characters without spaces?+

Yes — both counts are shown, because some limits (like application forms) count spaces and others do not.

## QR Code Generator

Turn any link or text into a QR code — download it as a crisp PNG.

Text or URLhttps://dusrel.com

Type something above to see your QR code.

That text is too long for a QR code. Try something shorter.

Size256 × 256 px512 × 512 px1024 × 1024 pxDownload PNG

The QR code is generated locally in your browser — your text is never sent to a server.

QR codes connect paper to the web: menus, posters, product packaging, event banners, business cards. Paste a link or text, and this tool builds a standard QR code you can download as a PNG in up to 1024×1024 — sharp enough for print.

Your QR code is a static code that points straight at what you entered — no redirect links, no tracking, no expiry date, and no watermark. It is generated locally in your browser.

## How to make a QR code
- 1

Enter your link or text

A website URL works best. Double-check spelling — the QR code will encode exactly what you type.
- 2

Watch it update live

The preview rebuilds as you type, so what you see is exactly what will scan.
- 3

Pick a size

512px is plenty for screens and small prints. Choose 1024px for posters and banners.
- 4

Download and test

Download the PNG, then scan it once with your own phone before printing or sharing it widely.

## Frequently asked questions

Do these QR codes expire?+

No. This is a static QR code — the information is encoded in the pattern itself, so it works forever, with no account or subscription behind it.

Can I use the QR code commercially?+

Yes — on menus, packaging, posters, cards, anywhere. The generated codes are free to use for personal and commercial purposes.

Is my link tracked?+

No. The code points directly at your URL — there is no Dusrel redirect in between, and generation happens locally, so we never see your link.

Which size should I download for printing?+

1024px for anything printed larger than a business card. Keep the printed code at least about 2×2 cm so phone cameras can focus on it.

## Age Calculator

Your exact age — years, months and days — plus a few fun totals.

Date of birth

As of dateCalculate age

0

Years

0

Months

0

Days

Total days lived—

Total weeks lived—

Next birthday—

Your dates never leave your device — the calculation happens entirely in your browser.

Exact age matters on government forms, exam applications, school admissions and insurance paperwork — and "about 20" is not good enough there. This calculator does proper calendar math, leap years included, from your date of birth to any date you choose.

Along with your exact age you get your total days and weeks lived, and a countdown to your next birthday. Your birth date never leaves your device.

## How to calculate your age
- 1

Enter your date of birth

Use the date picker and select the day, month and year you were born.
- 2

Optionally change the "as of" date

It defaults to today. Set any other date to find your age on that day — past or future.
- 3

Read your exact age

Years, months and days — the same format official forms ask for.
- 4

Check your next birthday

See the date and how many days are left until you turn a year older.

## Frequently asked questions

How is my exact age calculated?+

By calendar math: full years first, then full months, then remaining days — correctly borrowing days across months of different lengths and accounting for leap years.

Can I calculate age on a specific past or future date?+

Yes. Change the "as of" date to any day — for example the date of an exam or a form deadline — and the age is computed as of that date.

Is my date of birth stored or sent anywhere?+

No. The calculation runs entirely in your browser; Dusrel never sees or stores your birth date.

Why do forms ask for age in years, months and days?+

Because eligibility cut-offs (school admission, exams, jobs, pensions) are usually defined to the exact day. This format removes all ambiguity.

## Page: Password Strength Checker

Source: https://dusrel.com/pass/password-strength-checker/

[Tools](https://dusrel.com/pass/)/Password Strength Checker

## Password Strength Checker

How strong is your password, really? Find out — locally and honestly.

Show

Strength— · 0 bits of entropy

Estimated crack time: instant
- ✗At least 12 characters
- ✗Uppercase and lowercase letters
- ✗Contains a number
- ✗Contains a symbol
- ✗No obvious patterns (repeats, sequences, common words, years)

Checked locally in your browser only — the password you type is never sent anywhere or stored.

Honest tip: avoid typing a real password you currently use into any website tool, including this one. Test a similar made-up password instead.

Many passwords that look complex are surprisingly weak: short length, predictable patterns and reused words undo them. This checker estimates your password's entropy — its true unpredictability — from its length and character variety, and shows how long a fast offline attack would take to crack it.

It also flags the patterns attackers try first: sequences like 1234 and qwerty, repeated characters, common words and years. Everything runs locally in your browser; your password is never transmitted or stored.

## How to check a password
- 1

Type or paste a password

For safety, test a password similar to yours rather than one you currently use — the score will be representative.
- 2

Read the entropy and crack time

Entropy above 60 bits is strong; above 80 is excellent. Crack time assumes 10 billion guesses per second.
- 3

Fix what the checklist flags

Length first — every extra character multiplies the work an attacker must do. Then add variety and remove patterns.
- 4

Better: generate a random one

Humans are pattern machines. Use the Dusrel Password Generator for passwords that are random by construction.

## Frequently asked questions

Is it safe to type my password into a checker?+

This one runs 100% locally — the password never leaves your device, and nothing is logged. Still, as a habit, test a similar throwaway password rather than a live one, on any website including ours.

How is the crack time calculated?+

From entropy: a password with N bits of entropy needs on average 2^(N−1) guesses. We divide by 10 billion guesses per second — a fast offline attack on a leaked hash. Real-world times vary with the hash algorithm.

What entropy score should I aim for?+

At least 60 bits for everyday accounts and 80+ bits for email, banking and other important accounts. A random 16-character password clears 100 bits.

Does a strong score guarantee my account is safe?+

No. Strength only covers guessing. Reusing the same strong password across sites, or falling for phishing, defeats it — use unique passwords and a password manager.

## Page: About

ABOUT DUSREL

## Independent by design.

Dusrel is a one-developer company building free, privacy-first apps — your data stays yours, we never sell it.

## Our story

Dusrel started with a simple frustration: every useful app seemed to want your data in return. We believe software can be different — genuinely free, respectful of your privacy, and built to serve you instead of advertisers. So Dusrel became a one-developer mission to build the apps the internet deserves.

The Dusrel ecosystem — Image Quill, Ricsline, ResumeForge and PDF Tools — running right in your browser with nothing to install and no account needed. Eight more are on the way: Drive, Chat, Docs, Sheets, Notes, Mail, Meet and Calendar. One company, one account, one promise: your data stays yours — we never sell it.

## What we believe

### Privacy-first

No creepy tracking, no data brokers, no profiles built on your life. Your data stays yours — we never sell it.

### Free core

Every app’s core features are free, forever. No trials, no paywalls for the basics, no sign-up walls.

### Lightweight

No bloat, no dark patterns. Apps that open instantly, run smoothly, and respect your device.

### Honest

Plain-language promises, no fine-print tricks. If our practices ever change, we’ll say so clearly.

## Explore the ecosystem

Free apps that respect your privacy — and more are on the way.[Explore the apps](https://dusrel.com/#apps)

## Page: Security

Source: https://dusrel.com/security/

SECURITY

## Security you don’t have to think about

The safest data is data we never hold. Here’s how Dusrel keeps you secure — and how to report it when something looks wrong.

## Client-side by design

Our apps process your files right on your device. There’s no server full of your documents to leak, breach or subpoena — because your files never leave your hands.

## No accounts, nothing to steal

No passwords, no login databases, no password-reset emails to phish. With no accounts to hack, there’s simply less that can go wrong.

## Encrypted and hardened delivery

Everything is served over HTTPS with HSTS, so your browser always connects securely. Protective response headers — content-type sniffing protection, a strict referrer policy, frame protection and a restrictive permissions policy — are set on our pages, and the site is delivered through Cloudflare’s global network, which filters attacks before they reach us.

## Minimal data, minimal risk

We collect almost nothing — and you can’t lose what you don’t have. Read the privacy policy for the full picture.

## Careful apps and extensions

Our apps and browser extensions ask only for the minimum permissions they need to work. For example, the ShrinkIt extension touches only the image you right-click — nothing else in your browser. Install Dusrel software only from this website or the official stores, so you know it’s genuine and up to date.

## Kept up to date

We keep our dependencies under review and apply security fixes as they become available, prioritising anything that could affect visitors. The website is rebuilt from its public source code, so what runs is exactly what anyone can inspect.

## Open and auditable

The source of this website is public on GitHub. Open code keeps our security claims honest — anyone can check.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Found something? Email hello@dusrel.com with “Security report” in the subject. To help us verify and fix it quickly, please include:

• where the issue is — the page, app or extension, with the URL if there is one; • how to reproduce it — step-by-step instructions or a proof of concept; • what an attacker could do with it, in your assessment.

Our machine-readable security contact is published in line with RFC 9116 at dusrel.com/.well-known/security.txt.

## What to expect from us

We aim to acknowledge every genuine report within 3 business days, keep you informed while we investigate, and tell you when the issue is fixed. Fixes are prioritised by severity — critical issues first. In return, we ask for coordinated disclosure: please give us a reasonable window to fix the issue — normally up to 90 days — before publishing details, and we will agree the timing with you if more is needed.

We do not run a paid bug-bounty programme today; if that changes, this page will say so. With your permission, we are happy to credit researchers who report valid issues.

## Safe harbor and research rules

Good-faith security research that follows this policy is authorised by us, and we will not pursue legal action over it. In scope: dusrel.com, its subdomains, and Dusrel’s own apps and extensions. Out of scope: services run by others (such as Cloudflare, GitHub and the app stores) — please report those to their owners.

While researching, please: don’t degrade the Services (no denial-of-service or volumetric testing); don’t use social engineering or physical attacks; don’t access, modify or delete anyone else’s data — we hold almost none, but if you do encounter any, stop and tell us at once; and don’t harm our users or their devices. If you’re unsure whether a test is in scope, ask us first.

## Found a security issue?

Email us at hello@dusrel.com with the details — where the issue is, how to reproduce it, and what it could allow. We aim to acknowledge genuine reports within 3 business days and take every report seriously.[Report an issue](mailto:hello@dusrel.com?subject=Security%20report)

## Page: Privacy Policy

Source: https://dusrel.com/privacy-policy/

Legal

## Privacy Policy

Last updated: 20 October 2026

## The short version

Our apps and tools run on your device, so your files and text never reach us. We collect almost nothing, we never sell your data, and we use no ad trackers. This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics — a cookie-less tool that shows us only anonymous, aggregate statistics. Read on for the full details in plain language.

## Who we are and what this policy covers

Dusrel is an independent developer based in India. In this policy, “Dusrel”, “we”, “us” and “our” refer to Dusrel — the data controller (called a “Data Fiduciary” under India’s DPDP Act) for the little personal data described here.

This policy covers the Dusrel website (dusrel.com), our web apps (such as ShrinkIt, Image Quill, Ricsline, ResumeForge and PDF Tools), our free online tools, our browser extensions and our mobile apps — together, the “Services”. It explains what information is involved when you use them, why, and the rights you have — in India and worldwide.

## Our local-first promise

Almost everything our apps and tools do happens locally, on your own device. Files you open, images you edit, text you count, QR codes you generate and passwords you create or check are processed in your browser or app — they are never uploaded to us, never seen by us and never stored by us.

There are no user accounts on our website and tools today, so there is no profile, no password database and no usage history tied to your identity.

## Information we collect

Only the minimum that a website cannot avoid, in three narrow cases:

• Website analytics. This website uses Cloudflare Web Analytics to count visits and measure performance. It gives us aggregate statistics only — see “Cookies & analytics” below for exactly how it works.

• Hosting and security logs. Our host, Cloudflare, automatically processes standard technical information when you visit — such as your IP address, browser type and the pages requested — to deliver the site, keep it fast and protect it from attacks. This is the normal operation of the web; we do not use these logs to build profiles or identify visitors.

• Email you send us. If you write to hello@dusrel.com, we receive your email address and the contents of your message, so we can read and reply to it. That is the only personal data we knowingly hold about anyone.

## What we never do

We never sell or rent your personal data — to anyone, for any reason. We never share it with data brokers or advertisers. Our Services contain no advertising trackers, no third-party tracking cookies, no fingerprinting scripts and no social-media pixels. We do not build profiles of our users, and we do not track you across other websites.

## Cookies & analytics

We do not set any cookies of our own, and Cloudflare Web Analytics — which is active on this website — does not use cookies, local storage or any other client-side state to measure your visit. It does not fingerprint your device, and it does not track you across websites. What it measures is anonymous and aggregate: page views and visits, referrer pages, countries, device and browser types, and page-load performance timings. We see statistics, never individual visitors, and Cloudflare processes this data under its own privacy policy (cloudflare.com/privacypolicy).

One narrow exception: like most sites protected by Cloudflare, a strictly-necessary security cookie may be set in some situations to tell humans apart from bots and to stop abuse. Such cookies exist only for security — never for advertising or tracking — and they are exempt from consent requirements in most jurisdictions for that reason.

## How we use information, and our legal bases

We use the information described above only to: operate, secure and improve the Services; understand aggregate usage so we know which pages and tools are useful; and read and reply to emails you send us.

Where the GDPR or UK GDPR applies, our legal bases are our legitimate interests in running a secure, working website and understanding its aggregate use, and compliance with legal obligations where they arise. Where India’s DPDP Act applies, we process personal data for the purposes stated in this policy and for legitimate uses recognised by that Act. We do not use personal data for automated decision-making or profiling.

## Sharing and processors

We do not sell or share your personal information — including in the senses of “sell” and “share” under California law. The only company that processes data in order to run the Services is Cloudflare, Inc., which provides our hosting, content delivery, security and analytics, acting as our processor (service provider) under its own terms and privacy policy.

If you follow links from our Services to third-party sites (such as GitHub or app stores), those sites have their own privacy policies and we are not responsible for them. We would disclose information only if required by a valid legal obligation, and then only what the law requires.

## Data retention

Because your files and text never reach us, there is nothing of yours for us to retain. Analytics data is retained by Cloudflare in line with its own practices and is visible to us only as aggregate statistics. Emails you send us are kept only as long as needed to deal with your message and any related obligations, and are then deleted. Hosting and security logs are retained by Cloudflare for the limited periods described in its privacy policy.

## Data security

The strongest protection is architectural: your documents live on your device, so there is no server full of them to leak or breach. The Services are served over HTTPS, and the little data we do hold (such as your emails) is handled with standard security practices and accessed only to respond to you. No method of transmission or storage is completely secure, but keeping data off our servers removes most of the risk by design. See our Security page for more.

## Your rights — India and worldwide

Your rights depend on where you live, and we honour them wherever you are:

• In India (DPDP Act, 2023): you have the right to access a summary of your personal data and how it is processed, to ask for correction or erasure, to withdraw consent where processing is based on consent, to nominate someone to act for you, and to grievance redressal — first from us, and if unresolved, from the Data Protection Board of India.

• In the EU/EEA and UK (GDPR / UK GDPR): you have the rights of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability, and objection, the right to withdraw consent at any time where consent is the basis, and the right to complain to your local supervisory authority.

• In California (CCPA/CPRA): you have the right to know what personal information is collected, to request deletion and correction, to opt out of sale or sharing — we never sell or share, so there is nothing to opt out of — and to not be discriminated against for exercising your rights.

Because we hold almost nothing, most requests are simple. To exercise any right, email hello@dusrel.com. We will verify your request proportionately and respond within the time required by the law that applies to you (and in any case aim to reply within 30 days).

## Children’s privacy

The Services are built for a general audience and are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children. Under India’s DPDP Act, the personal data of anyone under 18 may be processed only with verifiable consent of a parent or lawful guardian, and we do not carry out tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children — we do none of those things for anyone. In the EU, similar protections apply to children under 16 (or lower, as set by local law), and in the US to children under 13. If you believe a child has sent us personal data (for example, by email), contact us and we will delete it.

## International transfers

Dusrel operates from India. Our processor, Cloudflare, runs a global network, so the technical data described above may be processed in countries other than yours. Cloudflare protects such transfers with the safeguards described in its privacy policy and data-processing terms, including standard contractual clauses where required.

## Do Not Track and privacy signals

We do not track you, so browser “Do Not Track” settings and Global Privacy Control signals have nothing to switch off here — our behaviour is the same either way: no tracking, no sale, no sharing.

## Changes to this policy

If our practices change, we will update this page and revise the “Last updated” date at the top. If a change is significant, we will draw attention to it on this page. We will never quietly weaken the core promises made here — local-first processing and never selling your data are permanent.

## Contact & grievances

For any question about this policy, to exercise your rights, or to raise a grievance, contact us at hello@dusrel.com. For users in India, this is also the contact for grievances under the DPDP Act and the IT Act — we will acknowledge your grievance and work to resolve it within the timelines those laws require. We read every message.

## Talk to us about privacy

We answer every email personally.[hello@dusrel.com](mailto:hello@dusrel.com)

LEGAL

## Terms of Service

Last updated: 20 October 2026

These terms cover your use of the Dusrel website, our free web apps and online tools, our browser extensions and mobile apps, and any files we make available for download (together, the “Services”). They are written in plain language on purpose — no legal maze. By using any of the Services, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the Services.

## Who we are

Dusrel is an independent developer based in India, building free, privacy-first software. In these terms, “Dusrel”, “we”, “us” and “our” refer to Dusrel; “you” refers to the person using the Services.

## The Services

Our apps and tools are free to use for personal and commercial work, and most of them run entirely in your browser or on your device — your files and text are processed locally and are not uploaded to us. You don’t need an account to use the Services today. If account-based features are ever introduced, additional terms may apply and we will say so clearly.

We work hard to keep the Services reliable and available, but we cannot guarantee uninterrupted or error-free operation, and features may change as the products evolve.

## Eligibility

You may use the Services only if you can form a binding contract under the laws that apply to you. If you are below the age of majority where you live (in India, under 18), you may use the Services only with the involvement and consent of a parent or legal guardian.

## Fair use

Please use the Services fairly and lawfully. In particular, do not:

• use the Services for anything illegal, or to process, create or distribute content you do not have the right to use; • scrape, crawl or hammer the Services in a way that burdens our infrastructure, or try to bypass security or access controls; • probe, scan or test the Services for vulnerabilities except through our responsible-disclosure process (see our Security page); • impersonate Dusrel or anyone else, or misrepresent your affiliation with us; • use the Services to harass, harm or defraud others, or to distribute malware or harmful code.

You are responsible for the content you create or process with the Services — your files, images, documents, QR codes, usernames and passwords — and for keeping your own backups. Because processing happens on your device, we cannot recover files or data for you.

## Downloads, extensions and apps

Software we offer for download (such as browser-extension packages) and our apps on official stores are provided free of charge under these terms. Please install Dusrel software only from this website or from official stores (the Chrome Web Store and Google Play) — copies from elsewhere are not authorised and may be unsafe. Updates may need to be installed manually for software distributed outside the stores.

## Intellectual property

Dusrel, the Dusrel name and logo, our app names and logos, and the design and content of the Services belong to us or our licensors. You’re welcome to link to our apps and mention them, but don’t copy them wholesale, remove our notices, or present our work as yours.

Content you create with our apps — your images, lyrics, resumes, PDFs and everything else — belongs to you, always. Because your content is processed on your device, we never receive it and claim no rights over it.

Some components of the Services are open source and are provided under their own licences; see our Open Source page for details. Those licence terms apply to those components.

## Privacy

Our privacy promise is part of these terms: your data stays yours — we never sell it. Our Privacy Policy explains in detail what little information is involved when you use the Services, and your rights over it.

## Third-party links and services

The Services may link to third-party websites and services (for example GitHub, app stores and social networks). Those are run by their own owners under their own terms and privacy policies; we are not responsible for them.

## No warranties

The Services are provided “as is” and “as available”, without warranties of any kind, express or implied — including fitness for a particular purpose and non-infringement — to the maximum extent permitted by law. Nothing in these terms excludes or limits any warranty or right that cannot lawfully be excluded under your local consumer law.

## Liability

In plain language: to the maximum extent the law allows, Dusrel isn’t liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential damages arising from your use of the Services, and our total liability is limited to the amount you paid us — which, since the Services are free, is zero.

Nothing in these terms limits liability that cannot lawfully be limited — for example, liability for fraud, or for death or personal injury caused by negligence — and nothing affects your statutory consumer rights.

## Changes to the Services

Dusrel is built by an independent developer, and the Services evolve: we may add, change, suspend or discontinue features or entire apps at any time. We’ll always try to give reasonable notice before removing something you rely on, but we can’t promise it. We may also suspend access for anyone who misuses the Services or breaks these terms.

## Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any dispute arising out of or relating to these terms or the Services will be subject to the jurisdiction of the competent courts in India, unless your local consumer law gives you the right to bring proceedings where you live.

## Changes to these terms

We may update these terms from time to time. When we do, we’ll update the “Last updated” date above. Continued use of the Services after a change means you accept the new terms.

## Page: Open Source

Source: https://dusrel.com/open-source/

Open Source

## Built in the open

Dusrel is built by an independent developer — and where possible, it is built in the open. Here is what that means.

## What's open

The source code of this website — dusrel.com itself — is public on GitHub. You can read every line, see how the landing page is put together, and suggest improvements. Not every Dusrel app is open source, but we open what we can.

[Star on GitHub](https://github.com/dusmamud/dusrel)Public repository: dusmamud/dusrel

## Our philosophy

### Transparency by default

When code is public, there is nothing to hide. Open source keeps our privacy claims honest and checkable.

### Community feedback

Ideas, bug reports and fixes from real users make the apps better than one person could alone.

### Learning in public

Building in the open means every decision, mistake and fix is visible — useful for anyone learning to build.

## How to contribute
- 1

### Pick something to improve

Browse the repository on GitHub. Found a typo, a bug, or an idea worth adding? That is your starting point.
- 2

### Open an issue or a pull request

Open an issue to discuss it, or send a pull request directly if you already have the fix.
- 3

### Say hello

Prefer email? Write to hello@dusrel.com with your idea or feedback — every message gets read.

## Like what you see? Give it a star.

A star on GitHub is the simplest way to support open work at Dusrel.[Star dusmamud/dusrel](https://github.com/dusmamud/dusrel)

Brand

## The Dusrel brand

Logos, colors and guidelines for using the Dusrel identity correctly.

## Logo

On light backgrounds

On dark backgrounds

[Download SVG](https://dusrel.com/logo.svg)[Download PNG](https://dusrel.com/logo.png)[Download Favicon](https://dusrel.com/favicon.svg)

## Colors

Primary#4d90fe

Background#121212

Surface#1e1e1e

Text#e8eaed

## Typography

Sora is our voice for headings and the wordmark — confident and modern. Inter carries the body text — clear and highly readable at any size.

Aa

Sora

Display · Wordmark · Headings

Aa

Inter

Body · UI · Text

## Tagline

Dusrel

YOUR PRIVACY MATTERS

## Do
- Use the logo on clean, uncluttered backgrounds
- Keep the primary blue #4d90fe for brand moments
- Give the logo clear space on all sides
- Use Sora for headings and Inter for body text

## Don't
- Don't stretch, rotate or redraw the logo
- Don't change the logo's colors
- Don't add shadows, glows or gradients to the logo
- Don't place the logo on busy or low-contrast backgrounds

## Page: Changelog

Source: https://dusrel.com/changelog/

CHANGELOG

## Changelog

Every launch and milestone, newest first.

October 2026

## dusrel.com launches

The new home of Dusrel goes live — in English and Hindi, with light and dark mode, and the full ecosystem story in one place.

October 2026

## PDF Tools launches

11 free client-side PDF tools — merge, split, compress and more. Your files never leave your device.

October 2026

## Image Quill rebrands

ImgLove becomes Image Quill — with a new quill-nib identity and its own home at imagequill.dusrel.com.

October 2026

## ResumeForge reaches 20 templates

The resume builder grows to 20 professional templates, with live A4 preview and free print-ready PDF download.

October 2026

## Ricsline launches

The LRC lyrics maker goes live — tap-to-sync timing, a built-in library, and one-click .lrc export.

October 2026

## ImgLove launches

The first Dusrel image app goes live — 8 free online image tools running entirely in your browser.

## What's next

The roadmap is where Dusrel is headed — see what’s available, what’s coming next, and what’s on the horizon.[View the roadmap](https://dusrel.com/#roadmap)
